---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Dual-Cushion Financing Discretion
EXPRESSION: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(dlc, at))), IND_RANK(RATIO(che, at)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Financing behavior should be most informative when firms simultaneously have low current-debt pressure and a strong cash cushion.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The minimum of the two ranks is a soft joint-capacity test: a firm receives a high financing weight only when both maturity safety and cash availability are favorable. This distinguishes genuine two-sided liquidity capacity from repeated transformations of net current debt while retaining the continuous EBITDA-yield leg.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Maturity-Weighted Liquidity-Capped Financing
EXPRESSION: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(MIN(prstkc, MAX(SUB(che, dlc), SUB(ABS(SUB(che, dlc)), ABS(SUB(che, dlc))))), sstk), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(dlc, at)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Repurchase credit limited by available liquidity should be most predictive when low current debt also makes the equity action discretionary.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The financing amount is first capped by actual cash remaining after current debt, preventing unsupported repurchase credit, and is then weighted by the archive's most reliable maturity state. This combines a dollar-based funding constraint with a stock-based discretion measure rather than adding multiple unrestricted penalties.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Operating Value with Organic Equity Accretion
EXPRESSION: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(ceq, 1), SUB(sstk, prstkc)), at)))
HYPOTHESIS: Operationally cheap firms should outperform when book equity grows through internally generated capital rather than external equity issuance.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Financing-adjusted book growth has independent accounting content because changes in common equity mechanically include issuance and repurchases. Pairing it with EBITDA yield tests whether the earlier organic-book alpha strengthens when cheapness is measured using operating fundamentals rather than book value itself.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Operating-Value Fundamental Action Confirmation
EXPRESSION: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(ADD(MUL(ADD(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at))), INDICATOR(GROWTH(sale, 1), 0)), MUL(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at))), INDICATOR(NEG(GROWTH(sale, 1)), 0)))))
HYPOTHESIS: EBITDA-cheap firms should outperform when growing sales validate repurchases, while contracting sales reinforce the adverse interpretation of issuance.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The hard growth-sign construction previously produced stronger portfolio evidence than continuous growth weighting, so this specification preserves the reliable conditioning rule. Replacing book-to-market with EBITDA yield isolates whether an operating valuation anchor improves FF5 alpha without changing the financing mechanism.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Continuous Debt-Service Capacity Timing
EXPRESSION: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(ebitda, dlc), at))))
HYPOTHESIS: Repurchases and issuance should convey more valuation information as operating earnings provide greater capacity to meet current debt.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The earlier binary EBITDA-above-current-debt gate produced reliable but weaker portfolio evidence and passed many firms. A continuous industry rank of asset-scaled coverage preserves all observations while differentiating degrees of operating debt-service capacity.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Cash-Diluted Maturity Burden
EXPRESSION: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(dlc, ADD(at, che))))))
HYPOTHESIS: Financing actions should be more informative when current debt is small relative to the firm's asset base augmented by liquid cash.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Scaling current debt by assets plus cash provides a continuous cash-sensitive maturity measure without the large zero-tie group created by positive-part net-debt truncation. It retains the broad coverage and stable continuous weighting associated with the strongest archived signal.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio

---CRITIQUE Dual-Cushion Financing Discretion---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Internally coherent and correctly signed, but it is the third re-weighting of the same EBITDA-yield-plus-net-repurchase core by a liquidity/maturity rank (Maturity-Weighted Financing Discretion, Cash-Adjusted Maturity Discretion), and MIN of two highly correlated balance-sheet ranks is unlikely to add information beyond the already-tested net-current-debt version.

---CRITIQUE Maturity-Weighted Liquidity-Capped Financing---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This is a mechanical mash-up of two archived signals (Liquidity-Capped Repurchase Credit and Maturity-Weighted Financing Discretion) and is structurally identical to Solvency-Weighted Liquidity Repurchase with dlc/at swapped for lt/at, so it is a cosmetic variant rather than a new mechanism.

---CRITIQUE Operating Value with Organic Equity Accretion---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The construction is clean and correctly signed, but it is Organic Book Accretion Value with only the value leg swapped from B/M to EBITDA yield, and the second leg (clean-surplus retained-earnings growth net of external equity) is close to the well-known net-share-issuance/retained-earnings anomalies, so the incremental content is thin.

---CRITIQUE Operating-Value Fundamental Action Confirmation---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Expression matches the hypothesis (positive-part repurchases gated on sales growth, negative-part issuance gated on sales contraction), but it is literally Fundamentally Validated Equity Action with ceq/mktcap replaced by ebitda/mktcap — a single-leg substitution already performed repeatedly across the archive.

---CRITIQUE Continuous Debt-Service Capacity Timing---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: A well-motivated binary-to-continuous refinement of Debt-Service-Covered Financing whose direction matches the hypothesis, though the reviewer should note that IND_RANK((ebitda-dlc)/at) largely blends profitability with the already-tested current-debt rank, so any gain may be a repackaged profitability tilt.

---CRITIQUE Cash-Diluted Maturity Burden---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 1
RATIONALE: Since che is already a component of at, dlc/(at+che) is a near-monotone rescaling of dlc/at for the vast majority of firms, making this an economically arbitrary denominator change that will reproduce the archived Maturity-Weighted Financing Discretion signal almost exactly.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Equity-Churn-Adjusted Retirement
EXPRESSION: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(SUB(prstkc, sstk), MIN(prstkc, sstk)), at)))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap firms should outperform when equity retirement is clean rather than offset by simultaneous gross issuance.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
REASONING: The overlap between gross repurchases and gross issuance measures equity churn that a net-repurchase signal treats as equivalent to clean retirement. Penalizing this overlap distinguishes genuine ownership contraction from buybacks that merely absorb compensation-related or other concurrent dilution.

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Unretained Equity Issuance Penalty
EXPRESSION: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), RATIO(MIN(MAX(SUB(sstk, prstkc), SUB(ABS(SUB(sstk, prstkc)), ABS(SUB(sstk, prstkc)))), MAX(SUB(SUB(sstk, prstkc), DELTA(ceq, 1)), SUB(ABS(SUB(SUB(sstk, prstkc), DELTA(ceq, 1))), ABS(SUB(SUB(sstk, prstkc), DELTA(ceq, 1)))))), at))))
HYPOTHESIS: Equity issuance should be especially adverse when the proceeds are not retained as growth in common equity.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
REASONING: The additional penalty is capped by positive net issuance and by the portion of that issuance not reflected in the change in common equity. This uses the accounting link between equity financing and book capital while leaving repurchasers and issuance that remains on the balance sheet unaffected.

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Dividend-Layered Buyback Surplus
EXPRESSION: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(MUL(RATIO(prstkc, at), INDICATOR(MIN(dvt, LAG(dvt, 1)), 0)), RATIO(sstk, at))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap firms should receive stronger repurchase credit when buybacks are layered on top of an established positive dividend policy.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
REASONING: Positive dividends in both the current and prior period identify firms for which repurchases are an incremental, discretionary distribution rather than a substitute for the regular payout. Gross issuance remains fully adverse, and the continuous sales-yield leg prevents non-dividend payers from collapsing into an event-only portfolio.

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Concurrent Dual-Claim Retirement
EXPRESSION: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(MIN(prstkc, MAX(NEG(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1)), SUB(ABS(NEG(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1))), ABS(NEG(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1)))))), sstk), at)))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap firms should outperform when they simultaneously retire equity and reduce debt, indicating surplus internal funding rather than a leveraged buyback.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite
REASONING: The minimum operator credits only the dollar amount jointly supported by gross repurchases and an actual decline in total debt, so pure deleveraging cannot drive the signal. Issuance remains fully adverse, while balance-sheet debt changes preserve better coverage than sparsely reported debt-flow fields.

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Persistent Equity Policy Confirmation
EXPRESSION: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(ADD(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), RATIO(SUB(MIN(prstkc, LAG(prstkc, 1)), MIN(sstk, LAG(sstk, 1))), at))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap firms with repeated repurchases should outperform, while expensive firms with repeated issuance should underperform more reliably than firms undertaking one-time transactions.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
REASONING: Current net financing remains fully represented, and the minimum of current and lagged gross flows adds a persistence bonus or penalty only when the same policy continues across periods. This avoids the large neutral bucket of the earlier concordance gate while testing financing-policy commitment with only one lag.
